title: HtmlColgroup
responsibility: Renders the native colgroup element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlColgroup.attributes
inputs.description: Native colgroup attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlColgroup.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native colgroup element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlColgroup
outputs.description: The actual native colgroup element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
